name: VagueBench
summary: Evaluates embodied agents on instructions with non-essential context removed but task semantics unchanged, across entities, procedures, constraints and prior knowledge, in AI2-THOR and on a real arm.
numbers: 1,303 instruction pairs, 6 agents; task success −19.65%, empty plans +54.10% (relative); persists on a real myCobot arm

why.dex: AI2-THOR primitives; scripted arm in the real case study.
why.cog: Must recover implicit constraints the instruction no longer states.
